'''Chapter 380''' is titled "Enies Lobby Main Island Express".

==Cover Page==
[[Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works"]], Vol. 16: "Miss Valentine Caught".

Sadly, the other agents can do nothing for [[Mikita|Miss Valentine]], whom [[Hina]] quickly [[Ori Ori no Mi|binds]] to a pillar.

(Meanwhile, [[Jango]] and [[Fullbody]] make a thorough inspection of their prisoner's parasol.)

==Short Summary==
The [[Rocketman]] crash lands into the main island.

==Long Summary==
Since [[Spandam]] is not answering, [[Baskerville]] commands that one hundred law-guard-corps are to defeat those at the front gate. [[Oimo]] continues to guard the entrance, however, [[Mozu and Kiwi]] have managed to unlock the gate and only need someone to push it open. Before he can attack them however, [[Paulie]] ties his rope around him and with the help of [[Sodom]] and [[Gomorrah]], causing him to spin round and round while the others open the gate and run through.

Outside, the defeated guards notice the [[Rocketman]] speeding towards the gate, with no sign of slowing down in the slightest. [[Yokozuna]] manages to smash the gate to an angle, causing the train to fly over the first gate. However, there appears to be no way to land safely.

Oimo finally appears to have fallen and the group made up of the [[Franky Family]] and [[Galley-La Company]] are seen standing upon his back. However, the [[Watchdog Unit of the Law]] appear and Paulie is stabbed by one, although luckily it is not fatal. Oimo gets back onto his feet only for the Rocketman to smash into his back. At first it appears unlikely any of them are okay, however all of them turn out to be okay. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Sanji]] take down a vast number of the enemy in seconds, when the [[Marines]] attack them.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Baskerville]] calls for the law-guard-corps to engage the [[Franky Family]] and [[Galley-La Company]].
*Noticing the front gate is closed, the [[Rocketman]] used the front fence to fly in the air over the gate.
**The [[Rocketman]] crashes into [[Oimo]], defeating him.
*All of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] have made it to the main [[Enies Lobby|island]].
